# CLAUDE.md: rebuild-path-acupuncture-site

Public website for The Rebuild Path Acupuncture (Amber Smith, L.Ac.) at Barefoot Sage Center, 14 E Birch Ave, Flagstaff, AZ 86001.

* This repository is PUBLIC. Never add books, financial records, patient information, passwords, intake forms, or anything from rebuild-path-books or rebuild_path_operations.
* Five pages in public/ (index, treatment, about, visits, contact) sharing public/styles.css. Pages are generated by python3 tools/build_pages.py: edit text there, then run it. No build step on Cloudflare. Cloudflare Workers serves the public folder (wrangler.jsonc), deployed by "npx wrangler deploy" on every push to main. Only files in public/ are on the website.
* Brand (Nov 3, 2026): clean and crisp. White and warm stone backgrounds, near black espresso text and buttons, a muted bronze accent used sparingly (thin lines, small labels), serif type, Amber's logo. Never bright or saturated colors. No hyphens or dashes in site copy.
* Booking: https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule.php?owner=39409020&calendarID=14435236 or call (928) 444 9411. No payments or health questions on the site.
* Copy rules: no promises of results; never the word "unhurried"; symptoms only, never diagnoses; no Tuina for now; never "myofascial release" or "lymphatic drainage".
* Hours shown are Barefoot Sage Center's published hours.
* Live address: https://rebuildpathacupuncture.therebuildpathacu.workers.dev
* Images: leaves, needles and cupping were made by Amber in ChatGPT (fine to use). Never add screenshots or images copied from other websites or textbooks.
